notes: Web 387 — the whole route build for the bus work: ROUTE-STOP-KID-NAMES-TRIP-PREVIEW-NOV8 + ROUTE-EDIT-AND-DAILY-SKIP-NOV8, shipped together (owner's rulings Nov 8, 2026 20:16-20:41 CST, watching Nirojini use the route the app read off her sheet). (1) Kid count AND NAME with the stop: every stop now carries its kids by name — on the upload confirmation card (On:/Off: per stop, from the very roster Save writes), in the Navigator plan card for the stop she is heading to, and in the plan itself (sheet roster minus today's absents — the counting's own truth). (2) Preview the entire trip: a whole-trip preview — the run's stops in sheet order with times and kids, beside the map carrying every placed stop as a NUMBERED pin with the chain line through them in order; unplaced stops stand in the list by name, passed over on the map, never dropped. It opens from the confirmation card before Save (the staged read's stop names are geocoded for the view only — never written) and any time from the Dispatch route card for a saved run. The preview performs zero writes (suite-proven byte-identical store). (3) The route saved BY NAME: the sheet's own id (RouteSheetFile.routeNameOf — 'CBE-0574' on her rideveza sheet) is persisted as the route's name and stands on the confirmation title, the standing-dispatch face, the route card, the plan card and the map chain; a nameless sheet falls back to the plain Morning/Evening words — nothing invented. (4) Morning and EVENING are the daily pair (his 20:17 correction): the sheet's PM run is the Evening run in every touched face; the midday NOON run is not daily and still has no home — unbuilt, as parked. (5) She is COVERING this route, so it can be DELETED (his 20:18 ruling): fenced, quiet delete doors at the bottom of the Route sheets card — per run or the whole route — behind a staged in-card confirm that says what happens; after a delete the route no longer stands as her dispatch, no plan walks for it, no kids count against it, and the name comes off her map; days already run stay byte-identical in her records, and a fresh route loads afterwards exactly as before. (6) She can EDIT any portion of the route herself (his 20:41 ruling): an Edit door per run opens the run's stops as an editable list — rename a stop, change its time, reorder, take a stop off, add a stop, place/fix its spot, and edit the route's name — one Save replaces the standing run and the plan follows; a stop keeps its roster and placed point through a rename/reorder (a renamed stop re-places by its new name); nothing writes before Save; an all-blank Save refuses — emptying a route is Delete's job. (7) She can adjust stops DAILY: the day's absent truth is by kid NAME — one absent tap drops that kid's home stop from the walk on BOTH runs (plan, Navigator chain, preview), a partial absence never drops a stop, and unabsentStop brings a stop back by clearing its kids' marks by name across both runs; any stop can also be skipped directly for today from the Manifest day view, the plan card, or the preview list. The standing route is never touched by a day adjustment (byte-identical across skip/un-skip; tomorrow it stands whole), the day record names skipped stops with their reason ('skipped today — kids absent'), and the preview labels itself 'today's trip, adjusted' vs 'the standing route'.
